## How to Change TG: Call to Action Widget Color?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-tg-call-to-action-widget-color/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can change the color of TG: Call to action widget title, content and many more.

Follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Content**> **Widgets.**
- Go to **TG: Call to action widget color**.
- Change the color of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Enable/Disable Social Profile Links of Author in Author Bio?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-enable-disable-social-profile-links-of-author-in-author-bio/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

Firstly, you need to add the links of Social Profile. To add the links of the social profile, follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Users **> **Your Profile**
- Add the Social Links in **User Social Links**.
- Then, Click on** Update Profile**.

To enable the social profile links of author:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Content > Single Post**
- Locate **Author Bio**.
- Put a checkmark on **Check to show the Social Profiles in the Author Bio**.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Enable/Disable Post Meta?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-enable-disable-post-meta/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

There are variable options available in the Post Meta Display like disable date, comments, author, categories, etc.

## How to Display Category Description?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-display-category-description/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

WordPress allows you to add descriptions for your categories. To add the description for categories, go to **Posts **> **Categories**, then edit the category and add the description. However, if you are creating the new category then you can simply add category name and description.

Spacious Premium version allows you to display those description, all you need to do is:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Content > Blog/Archive**
- Scroll to locate **Category Options.**
- Put a checkmark on **Activate Term Description.**
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Change the Style of Post/ Page title?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-style-of-post-page-title/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

To change the style of Post/Page title:

- Go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> **Content -> Page Header**
- Scroll to locate **Header Title.**

i. **Background Color: **Choose the required background color for theheader title and click on publish.

ii. **Background Image: **Click on the select image and choose the image you wish to set as the background image for the header title. Click on the publish button to save the changes.

iii. **Background Image Position: **Background Image position allows you to easily control the horizontal and vertical position of the image. Just choose the option and click on publish.

iv. **Background Image Size: **You can choose the background image size depending on your preferences, whether to show full image or complete area of the row. Just choose the option and click on publish.

v. **Background Image Attachment : **You can either select scroll or fixed, depending upon the preferences. Choose the option and click on publish.

vi. **Background Image Repeat: **You can select the option and click on publish.

## How to Enable Author Bio in Post Page?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-enable-author-bio-in-post-page/>

Spacious theme allows you to display the author bio in post page, all you need to do is follow the steps listed below:

- Go to **Appearance > Customize > Content > Single Post**
- Go to **Author Bio**
- Put a checkmark on **Check to enable the author bio section just below the post.**
- Click on **Publish**.

---

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-enable-featured-image-in-page/>

To enable the Featured Image in Single Page, follow the steps listed below:

## How to Display Related Posts?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-display-related-posts/>

To display the Related Post, follow the steps below:

- Go to **Appearance > Customize > Content > Single Post**
- Scroll to **Related Posts.**
- Put a checkmark on ** Check to activate the related posts.**
- Click on **Publish**.

You can also filter the related post by categories and tags. You can select the option either **Related Posts By Categories **or **Related Posts By Tag **to display the related post by categories or tags.

---

## How to Manage Blog Post Display Type?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-manage-blog-post-display-type/>

There are varieties of options available which you can use to display the Blog post in your site. All you need to do is follow the steps listed below:

## How to Disable Header Title?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-disable-header-title/>

To disable the Header Title , follow the steps below:

- Go to **Appearance > Customize > Content > Page Header.**
